The former foes met at a five-star hotel a few blocks from Trump Tower in Manhattan late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN general assembly. items.title: President Meloni’s video message to the fourth edition of the international ‘Risorsa Mare’ forum
items.summary: Dear Nello, dear friends, Thank you for organising the ‘Risorsa Mare’ forum once again this year and for holding it in La Spezia, a city that tells the story of Italy’s connection with the sea, its economy and its strategic reach in an extraordinary way. For a nation like ours, the sea has never been merely a border; it is a natural infrastructure that links Italy to the rest of the world, supports our exports, fuels our industrial sectors of excellence and holds huge potential in terms of energy, innovation and research. This is why we chose from day one to build a real policy for the sea, able to pool expertise, resources and vision. Parliament has just approved a law on enhancing the sea as a resource, which is clearly a crucial step along this path, enabling us to provide professionals and industry groups with the answers they have been waiting decades for and to govern what is a crucial asset for our competitiveness in a coordinated way. We are proud to be able to say that we are on the right track. items.title: Dichiarazione del Presidente Meloni
items.summary: La notizia della tragica scomparsa di Andrea Moretti, operaio specializzato deceduto questa notte in seguito ad un incidente al Colosseo, ci colpisce e ci addolora profondamente. Voglio esprimere il mio cordoglio e la mia vicinanza alla famiglia, ai suoi cari e ai suoi colleghi in questo difficilissimo momento. E formulare l’auspicio che sia fatta piena luce, nel più breve tempo possibile, sull’accaduto. Morire a 22 anni è inaccettabile, e lo è ancora di più se questo accade sul posto di lavoro. Anche nel nome di Andrea continueremo a fare la nostra parte, ad impegnarci e a compiere ogni sforzo affinché tragedie simili non si ripetano più.
